messages.subject: Poster Predictive Checks for Citizen Science Dynamic Occupancy Models
parts:
Hello, 

It is unclear to me how one would implement the posterior predictive distribution checks (Section 4.8.2 from AHM Vol 2) in the context of an analyzing a citizen science data set where one has eliminated missing/empty observations (site/year combinations that were not observed) (section 4.10.2 from AHM Vol 2).  

Has anyone implemented the checks in this context? If so, I would greatly appreciate sample code.  

Best Regards,

Brian Tavernia
